summary.text: Gerry Ward is the incumbent Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the House as beginning in 2012.

paragraphs.text: Ward earned a Ph.D. from Boston University.

His career experience includes working as the curator of the Portsmouth Historical Society, the editor of the Portsmouth Marine Society Press, and a visiting lecturer with the Massachusetts College of Art and Design.
Ballotpedia lists his past committee assignments as including the Election Law Committee in sessions from 2013 through 2022.
